evidence.what: Dense cars, trucks, vans and motorcycles filling all lanes
Congestion extends far upstream with no crash visible

verdict.summary: Heavy congested traffic with cars and motorcycles, no incident visible.
verdict.details: Elevated view of tree-lined multi-lane road packed with cars, trucks, vans and large numbers of motorcycles in slow-moving congestion stretching far into distance. Adjacent highway also busy. People on motorcycles and sidewalks, no crash, stalled vehicle, or emergency responders clearly visible.
